findings: Part B B-1.2 confirms a full-time 180 EC Dutch/part-English ST&I degree, code 50993. B-4.3 lists the same ten-unit, 54 EC materials specialisation including Quantum Physics 1, 50921QUA6Y, six credits in period five. Its footnote restricts specialisation courses to students registered in that specialisation. The detailed programme and dated catalogue course are consistent about this requirement, but the generic course entry text remains unchanged and does not expressly list ST&I.

The adopted Part B is dated 15 September 2026 and effective 31 August 2026. Faculty A-1.1 defines Parts A and B together as the programme regulations; A-3.2 places course composition and supplemental admission provisions in Part B. A-4.1.6 states that participation also requires meeting individual course-entry conditions. Part B does not expressly reconcile the generic Quantum Physics restriction with its required specialisation placement. Board Rules Article 1.2 gives precedence to the OER over conflicting Board rules, but supplies no course-specific waiver or corrected Quantum Physics access clause. No access exception is inferred solely from the requirement listing or from advisory physics preparation.

The second attempt therefore strengthens the prescribed course composition without certifying accessible completion of the missing six credits.
